import os
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']='1'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,datetime,math,zipfile
r=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0,str(r/'workspaces/arch03/scripts'))
import n1_data as data
import n1_precision as numeric
import numpy as np
h=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
out=Path(__file__).parent
proof_path=r/'handoff/team/evidence/N1_FLOAT100_SOURCE_RECOVERY_20261113.json'
assert h(proof_path.read_bytes())=='988e5e96a42eea61c2c348626b24f1252556da166f48653d30218452af905f89'
proof=json.loads(proof_path.read_text());assert proof['passed'] and proof['checked']==100
archive=r/'local_runs/n1_precision_delivery_20261113_0840/n1-recovered-float100-20261113.zip'
assert h(archive.read_bytes())=='5df11251821d2d36e85e07c8a171195d9d2ed2d4084a979519d23f6df7d683e2'
converter=data.converter_module();rows=[];root='n1-recovered-float100-20261113/'
started=datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
with zipfile.ZipFile(str(archive)) as z:
 raw=z.read(root+'shared_weights.npz');assert h(raw)==proof['shared_weights_sha256'];w,b=converter.arrays(raw,weights=True)
 for sample in proof['samples']:
  sn=sample['sample'];raw=z.read(root+'sample_%03d/float_tensors.npz'%sn);assert h(raw)==sample['sample_float_sha256'];x,y=converter.arrays(raw)
  for li in range(12):
   xq,xc=converter.quantize(x[li],10,14);wq,wc=converter.quantize(w[li],12,12);bq,bc=converter.quantize(b[li],22,32)
   result,mn,mx=numeric.independent_reference(xq,wq,bq);other=converter.reference(xq,wq,bq)
   assert all(np.array_equal(result[k],other[k]) for k in result)
   delta=result['result'].astype(np.float64)/4096.-y[li];sse=float(np.sum(delta*delta,dtype=np.float64));energy=float(np.sum(y[li]*y[li],dtype=np.float64));error=100*math.sqrt(sse/25344)/max(math.sqrt(energy/25344),1e-8)
   hashes={k+'.hex':h(converter.encode(result[k],bits)) for k,bits in [('total',33),('result',16),('saturated',1)]}
   hashes['load.hex']=h(converter.encode(np.asarray(converter.pack(xq,wq,bq)),16))
   rows.append(dict(sample=sn,layer=li+1,outputs=25344,sse=sse,reference_energy=energy,nrmse_percent=error,clipping=dict(x=xc,w=wc,b=bc),saturated=int(result['saturated'].sum()),accumulator_min=mn,accumulator_max=mx,derived_hex_sha256=hashes))
  if sn%10==0:print('LOCAL_NUMERIC_PROBE',sn,flush=True)
layers=numeric.aggregate(rows)
report=dict(schema='n1-local-float100-numeric-probe-v1',status='software_numeric_passed_server_hex_join_pending',started=started,finished=datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),samples=100,tasks=1200,outputs=30412800,source_proof_sha256=h(proof_path.read_bytes()),archive_sha256=h(archive.read_bytes()),script_sha256=h(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),independent_reference_sha256=h(Path(numeric.__file__).read_bytes()),converter_sha256=h(data.CONVERTER.read_bytes()),max_layer_nrmse_percent=max(v['nrmse_percent'] for v in layers),max_task_nrmse_percent=max(v['nrmse_percent'] for v in rows),clipping={k:sum(v['clipping'][k] for v in rows) for k in ('x','w','b')},saturated=sum(v['saturated'] for v in rows),layer_aggregate=layers,cases=rows,server_original_hex_verified=False,rtl_precision_join_verified=False,n1_stage_accepted=False)
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in ('cases','layer_aggregate')},indent=2))
